title: Go behind the scenes at the Grand Ole Opry
description: A backstage tour of the Grand Ole Opry takes you into the rooms and corridors performers use before stepping into country music’s best-known circle. Hear stories of the artists who have played here, see how the show comes together, and imagine the nerves just before the curtain rises. Pair it with a live performance if your schedule allows.
teaser: Follow performers’ footsteps behind Nashville’s famous stage.
goodToKnow: Before you go, confirm compatible show/tour times and walking requirements.
whyItMightDelightYou: The tour gives a familiar music institution a human scale, from dressing room to spotlight.
